title: Best AI GLB animation tool?
author: founders_keepers
selftext:
I have a gorilla model exported from 3d ai studio.

I'm now looking to add animation to it.

The built in one does not recommend animating animals, mostly used for character animation.

What's the best tool on the market I can buy to do this for me? I really don't want to learn blender.

comments.author: Derefringence
comments.body: Try mixamo, it's a tool by Adobe

replies.author: founders_keepers
replies.body: ok perfect. that's what i've been told. ty!

replies.author: TruWaves
replies.body: But its not AI and cant do animal animations.

replies.author: founders_keepers
replies.body: hm. any tool you recommend or it's blender time?

replies.author: Derefringence
replies.body: You can also use meshy (paid) to generate and rig basically anything

replies.author: Derefringence
replies.body: It is AI since it uses machine learning

comments.author: AutomaticAnywhere859
comments.body:
I have a modelling agent using AI: 3d-agent-com  
I can finetunning it for animation if you want to use. Just drop a comment that I can build for you

comments.author: One-Area-2896
comments.body: There are no tools to make 3d animations so far. Mixamo and accurig have preinstalled animations, but only for bipedal animals (aka mostly humans). You can use it on your gorilla, but it will walk like a human and with the long arms it’ll look weird.
